title: Tech Note: License Installation Problems and Solutions

historical_commentary.text: This note documents licensing mechanics specific to the classic 4D v6.5-era product and expansion license system, including serial numbers and the transition to a "diskless" expansion license scheme on both Mac and Windows — infrastructure that has been completely replaced by 4D's modern licensing systems since. The specific troubleshooting steps are entirely obsolete since 4D's licensing architecture (activation, license files, cloud-based license management) has changed multiple times in the decades since, but the note is a useful historical record of how software licensing friction was handled in the pre-internet-activation era of desktop database software.
related_updates: 4D's licensing system has been completely replaced multiple times since 2000, including moves toward online activation and license management distinct from physical/diskless serial schemes of this era
The specific serial-number and diskless-license troubleshooting steps in this note no longer apply to any current 4D licensing mechanism
